onset.start_occupied: Oracle 1, v30 0; the diagnosis baseline is 0. Every other result.json field, result_queries.csv and result_negatives.json equal the oracle's. The probe computes start_occupied = getInflateOccupancy(start, yaw), where yaw = collisionSegmentYaw(start, target) is the heading toward the target the run chose. The baseline chose the old target and checked yaw -1.5711; its front footprint circle's centre falls in cell (20,74), whose 1.149 m layer is Flat in v29. The oracle and v30 chose the same new target (-4.914,-3.465,1.844) and checked yaw -1.5399; the front circle's centre falls in cell (21,74). That cell's 1.149 m layer is Unknown in v29's labels. It lies outside the oracle's relabelled walkway layers (1.35-1.65 m in the landing box), so the oracle keeps it Unknown, fails the support check and records 1. v30 labels it Flat and records 0. The support check alone predicts all three recorded values (versions/v30/difference_analysis/onset_start_support.json). This is v30's intended map-wide rule reaching a ring cell the box-limited oracle did not relabel, not a planner difference.
